environment.description: Terraform provider runs as a pod in an EKS cluster (namespace: terraform-runners). The pod has a service account with an IAM role attached via IRSA (IAM Roles for Service Accounts). The node's instance metadata service (IMDS) is accessible at 169.254.169.254 with IMDSv1 enabled (no token required). No NetworkPolicy resources are applied to the terraform-runners namespace. The internal workspace API at ACME_API_ENDPOINT trusts any request bearing a valid IAM token without verifying workspace ownership against the caller's identity.
